decision.observation: Hornet has leapt up-right onto the edge of the mossy right cliff, level with the snail-wheel's shell head. The ornamented green background and hanging vine curtains fill the grotto, and the stone-tiled path remains below. Hornet is facing right, near the cliff edge.
decision.hypothesis: The right cliff top may continue into a further passage or ledge that leads out of this grotto pocket. Moving right along the cliff top will test it.
decision.memory: Western snail-wheel grotto: right cliff is climbable; Hornet now at its edge.
